title: The Searing Palm Discipline
summary: The Azure Sky school discipline of the glowing palm that brands the foe and melts the guard it meets.

title: The Azure Magma Canon
summary: The school canon of a field of azure-hot magma qi that melts steel and stone alike under open skies.

title: The Crown of Living Magma
summary: The apex Azure Sky discipline in which a formed core wears a crown of living magma that moves at its keeper's will.

title: The Gale Cinder Course
summary: The Gale school course in which the wind carries burning cinders to the foe and fans them to a fierce heat.

title: The Wind-Sworn Lava Canon
summary: The school canon of lava sworn to the wind that rides every gust to the foe and burns hotter for it.

title: The Oath of the Burning Core
summary: The apex Gale discipline in which a formed core is sworn to a fire that never cools and is spent only at the keeper's word.
